newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold ends at day's high in Hong Kong on late buys.
newsitem.headline: Gold ends at day's high in Hong Kong on late buys.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended at the day high on Monday, climbing from New York's close on late overseas buying and short-covering interest, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$350.20/70 an ounce from New York's US$348.30/80 close on Friday and Saturday's Hong Kong close of US$349.30/80.
"Overseas players bought gold in the afternoon, but not too much," said a dealer at a local investment house. "The immediate gold trend is uncertain as the market lacks a clear direction."
"I think the price will stay range-bound, with downside support at US$348 and upside resistance at US$358," he said.
Local gold ended HK$7 higher at HK$3,244 a tael.
The carry over charge per 10 taels of gold at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -4.00 from its Saturday fix at +9.79.
